mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, chosen because it is a pure Rust implementation and avoids the CVE exposure of a C-based TLS library.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
